messages.author: 7a4a5fe753932e1a
messages.subject: testing model convergence in inlabru
parts:
Dear Finn,

I am working with a joint model including a nonlinear effect. I have a doubt how to interpret the inlabru output in order to assess my model convergence.

The " verbose" output states that

iinla: Max deviation from previous: 3.17% of SD, and line search is active [stop if: <10% and line search inactive]

So, the max deviation is < 10%, the bru congergence plots look fine (attached here), but "line search is active".

How to interpret this result? Can I trust my results or not? Usually, to assess the model convergence I look for the sentence "convergence met" in the verbose output. In this case the "convergence met" statement is missing but the above-mentioned results seem to indicate model convergence.

Regards,
Guido
